about: Wellesley is a township in Waterloo Region, Ontario, west of Kitchener–Waterloo—not a city. Mennonite farm country, the village of Wellesley, and crossroads hamlets such as St. Clements and Linwood sit among rolling fields on the region’s rural western edge. About 11,000 people live in Wellesley Township.
